name: agent-guardrails
description: Agent permissions and human in the loop for AI agents: map which tools and actions an agent may take alone, set escalation rules and an approval workflow, run an agent permissions review against runtime settings, and check traces for actions taken before approval. Use when you ask which tools an agent should have (least-privilege tool access), when a person must approve or take over, or whether your agent guardrails match the settings. Works from your pasted tools, policy, configs, traces and logs. Not for connection repair, factual answer scoring or general code security scanning.
